messages:
Alice M.: Heads-up: ACME reported their embeddings usage chart shows units labeled as 'tokens' but the magnitude lines up with vector counts and looks roughly 2x. Screenshot sent: https://files.redwood/acme/embeds_dash_v2.png

Ben (Support): Got it. Please share org id, invoice reference, and the affected time range so I can link to billing.

Alice M.: org: org_acme_22, invoice INV-2026-03-08, window: 2026-03-06 00:00 -> 2026-03-06 12:00 UTC. They say client code unchanged. Billing flagged a spike too.

Carol - Billing: I see a $1.2k uplift on INV-2026-03-08 attributed to embeddings. Need to confirm whether units were misattributed before we consider a credit.

ingest-bot: [alert] ingestion lag + consumer rebalance observed on topic 'embeds-events' at 2026-03-06T02:14:07Z; max lag ~18m

Dave (eng-oncall): Initial hypotheses: (A) UI label wrong, (B) metering pipeline mapped embed routes to token units, (C) replay/dup caused double-count. Which components emitted metrics during that window?

Maria (SRE): Kafka shows a partition rebalance 02:10-02:18Z and consumer restarts. A number of messages ended up reprocessed because incoming records lacked stable keys. That would explain duplicate aggregates.

Ben (Support): Customer shared a sanitized sample request:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rwd-embed-1024",
  "input": "...",
  "user": "acme-ingest-service"
}
```
They say a worker retries on 5xx and sometimes replays a batch. In a few cases they didn't retry but still saw doubled numbers.

Dave (eng-oncall): Can we get any request_id or x-rwd-request headers? Our aggregator currently relies on (org_id, time_bucket, route) which is not unique; if replayed messages arrive they increment counts again.

Alice M.: Sample event has no request_id, only client_ts and no batch_id. Their SDK didn't attach an id.

Dave (eng-oncall): I reproduced quickly: 1) send message without key, 2) trigger consumer rebalance, 3) replay same message -> metrics-agg increments twice. Also found mapping table issue: some embed routes are tagged as 'tokens' in route->unit mapping. SQL from aggregator:
```
INSERT INTO aggregate_embeds (org, unit, count)
SELECT org_id, 'tokens' as unit, sum(cnt)
FROM raw_events
GROUP BY org_id, time_bucket
```
We should map route 'embed.*' -> 'vectors' but a stale mapping entry causes 'tokens'.

Eve (Product): So two separate customer-impacting bugs: wrong unit mapping for certain routes (labels + unit type) AND lack of deterministic event keying leading to duplicate counts on replay. Need triage and timeline.

Ben (Support): Customer wants immediate mitigation — can we hide unit column or add a prominent note in the dashboard? They also asked about provisional credit.

Dave (eng-oncall): Proposed mitigations:
- Short term: add a dashboard tooltip and temporary note about an ongoing investigation (feature-flagged)
- Mid term: require/derive event_id in ingress (prefer request_id header, else use deterministic payload hash) and make producer libs emit keys
- Long term: backfill/dedupe job to recompute affected aggregates and then reconcile billing

Maria (SRE): I'll snapshot the raw_events partition for the window and run a dedupe dry-run in staging. I'll also adjust consumer group settings to reduce rebalance churn.

Dave (eng-oncall): I'll prepare a hotfix: (1) fix mapping table so embed routes map to 'vectors', (2) add dedupe logic in metrics-agg keyed by event_id. Plan: canary in 1h, full roll after smoke tests. Canary id: 1968770001.

Ben (Support): I'll update ACME: "We're investigating a metrics duplication and unit-mapping issue caused by a rare ingestion replay plus a route mapping bug. We'll provide corrected usage numbers and process credits if your invoice was inflated." Offering provisional hold on billing until we confirm.

Carol - Billing: Please attach the final corrected window and numbers before any adjustment. I'll prepare a billing hold for INV-2026-03-08 pending engineering's backfill.

ingest-bot: [deploy] metrics-agg hotfix canary started at 2026-03-06T04:12:03Z

Dave (eng-oncall): Canary passed smoke for 30m; metrics stabilized. Scheduling prod roll at 04:45Z and backfill plan thereafter.

Alice M.: Thanks all. Keeping thread open for two-hourly customer updates until resolved. :white_check_mark:
